1. New .github/workflows/v3-production-derived-purge.yml:
   - on: workflow_dispatch only. Inputs: mode as a type: choice listing exactly the action's closed mode list (plan, status, authorize, verify-system-archetype-empty, delete-<4 relations>, rewrite-<4 relations>, restore-services, abort-relation-<4 relations>, complete) -- no free-text mode; confirm_target that must equal the literal ed-finder-prod/nb79a3d.mevnode.com; plan_run_id (the run id of the successful plan run whose sealed plan artifact this dispatch uses, digits only) and plan_sha256 (hex 64) required for every mode except plan and status; verification_run_id + verification_sha256 required where the action needs the sealed archetype-empty proof; acknowledge_failed_stop (digits only, optional, only admitted for restore-services); wall_clock_seconds bounded integer for delete modes. No input may name a host, path, relation outside the choice, or SQL.
   - environment: v3-production. permissions: contents: read plus only what downloading the plan/verification artifact from another run of this same workflow needs (actions: read). Authenticate those artifacts by run id: the run must be a successful run of this workflow on main for mode plan (or verify-system-archetype-empty) and the artifact's sealed SHA-256 must equal the input.
   - workflow-level concurrency group v3-production-application-authority (cancel-in-progress: false) AND job-level concurrency group chatgpt-ed-new-ops (cancel-in-progress: false), exactly as the design requires.
   - After approval, re-fetch and require the exact current main SHA (same pattern as the schema-migration workflow); the source SHA passed to the action is that SHA.
   - Pinned known-host SSH using the existing ED_NEW_OPERATOR_* / V3 production credential boundary already used by the protected workflows (reuse the same secret names; never ssh-keyscan; StrictHostKeyChecking=yes; BatchMode; IdentitiesOnly).

   - The job must STAY RUNNING until the remote action has exited (normal exit, budget expiry, FAILED_STOP), polling it; for rewrite modes the monitor outlives the job by design and that is fine. Job timeout-minutes above the action's wall-clock budget plus the longest batch/rewrite allowance; document the numbers.
   - tee the JSON receipt; upload receipts with if: always(), if-no-files-found: error, retention-days: 180; the plan and verify-system-archetype-empty runs upload their sealed artifacts under fixed names so later runs can authenticate them.
